description: #5057 — the op-log maintenance pair: `compact_op_log_cmd` and `get_compaction_status`. Both were waived as 'op-log maintenance, not projected block state', which the snapshot's own `op_log_digest` contradicts — the log IS compared across the stacks, so counters over it are comparable too. What this corpus can reach is bounded by the clock, not by the scope: the cutoff is `now()` minus a window floored at `MIN_RETENTION_DAYS = 7`, and every op a fixture replays is minted during the run, so nothing is ever eligible and `ops_deleted` is deterministically 0. That leaves the fresh-log no-op path and the `retention_days` floor, and the floor is where the mock diverged: `compact_op_log_cmd` was a constant stub that answered success for the `0` the guard exists to refuse. `get_compaction_status`'s `oldest_op_date` is NOT projected — it is `MIN(op_log.created_at)`, a clock reading taken while the fixture replays, so a recorded value would bind to the millisecond it was authored on.
name: op_log_compaction

ops.comment: The whole op log this fixture has: one op, minted now, and therefore never eligible for any legal retention window.
The floor itself, accepted. Nothing is older than seven days, so the pre-flight count is zero and the command returns before it takes the writer lock.
ops.name: compact_at_the_floor_deletes_nothing

ops.comment: `DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS`, the window the status below reports. Same answer, for the same reason.
ops.name: compact_at_the_default_window_deletes_nothing

ops.comment: One day under `MIN_RETENTION_DAYS`. Refused at the IPC boundary before any DB work — the mock accepted it.
ops.name: compact_refuses_one_day_under_the_floor

ops.comment: The value the floor exists for: a zero window sets cutoff = now() and would purge the whole log down to the snapshot frontier in one call.
ops.name: compact_refuses_a_zero_window

queries.comment: The observation: the log still holds its one op, none of it is eligible, and the reported window is the constant `DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS` rather than anything the calls above passed.
queries.name: status_after_the_compactions
